notices.title: Boring under load.
notices.body: The system worth having is the one still running after you have stopped watching it.
notices.cite: Scrapy, Sep 2025: breakers on the Delta Lake, Redis and HTTP services.

notices.title: Keep the log. Raw before clean.
notices.body: The question you will want next month is one you cannot ask today, so the raw layer is appended to and never overwritten.
notices.cite: Scrapy, Sep 2025, the Delta Lake tables; rustmapper, Oct 2025, the write-ahead log.

notices.title: Lights before speed.
notices.body: A crawler you cannot watch is a crawler you cannot trust; dashboards go in version one.

notices.title: The surface is part of the system.
notices.body: A tool that confuses its operator is already failing.
notices.cite: This page, Nov 2025: its earlier editions read as a template.
